cues.en: Let's get back to the details of how DRAM works and zoom in to explore a single memory cell situated in a massive array.

cues.en: This memory cell is called a one t one c cell
cues.zh: 这种存储单元称为 1T1C 单元

cues.en: and is a few dozen nanometers in size.
cues.zh: 尺寸只有几十纳米。

cues.en: It has two parts, a capacitor to store one bit of data in the form of electrical charges or electrons,
cues.zh: 它有两个部分，一个电容，以电荷或电子的形式存储一位数据，

cues.en: and a transistor to access and read or write data. The capacitor is shaped like a deep trench dug into silicon and is composed of two conductive surfaces separated by a dielectric insulator or barrier just a few atoms thick,
cues.zh: 和一个晶体管，用来访问和读取或写入数据。电容的形状像一条深深挖进硅中的沟槽，由两个导电表面组成，中间隔着一层只有几个原子厚的介电绝缘体或势垒，

cues.en: which stops the flow of electrons but allows electric fields to pass through. If this capacitor is charged up with electrons to one volt, it's a binary one.
cues.zh: 它阻止电子流动，但允许电场通过。如果这个电容被充入电子到一伏特，它就是二进制的1。

cues.en: And if no charges are present and it's at zero volts, it's a binary zero. And thus, this cell only holds one bit of data. Designs of capacitors are constantly evolving, but in this trench capacitor,
cues.zh: 如果没有电荷存在、处于零伏特，它就是二进制的0。因此，这个单元只保存一位数据。电容的设计在不断演进，但在这个沟槽电容中，

cues.en: the depth of the silicon is utilized to allow for larger capacitive storage while taking up as little area as possible.
cues.zh: 利用硅的深度来实现更大的电容存储，同时占用尽可能小的面积。

cues.en: Next, let's look at the access transistor and add in two wires.
cues.zh: 接下来，我们来看访问晶体管，并加入两根导线。

cues.en: The word line wire connects to the gate of the transistor,
cues.zh: 字线导线连接到晶体管的栅极，

cues.en: while the bit line wire connects to the other side of the transistor's channel.
cues.zh: 而位线导线连接到晶体管沟道的另一侧。

cues.en: Applying a voltage to the word line turns on the transistor,
cues.zh: 给字线施加电压会打开晶体管，

cues.en: and while it's on, electrons can flow through the channel thus connecting the capacitor to the bit line. This allows us to access and charge up the capacitor to write a one or discharge the capacitor to write a zero. Additionally,
cues.zh: 当它开启时，电子可以流过沟道，从而把电容连接到位线。这让我们能够访问电容并给它充电以写入1，或给电容放电以写入0。此外，

cues.en: we can read the stored value in the capacitor by measuring the amount of charge.
cues.zh: 我们可以通过测量电荷量来读取电容中存储的值。

cues.en: However, when the word line is off, the transistor is turned off and the capacitor is isolated from the bit line thus saving the data or charge that was previously written.
cues.zh: 不过，当字线关闭时，晶体管也随之关闭，电容与位线隔离，从而保存之前写入的数据或电荷。

cues.en: Note that because this transistor is incredibly small, only a few dozen nanometers wide, electrons slowly leak across the channel. And thus, over time, the capacitor needs to be refreshed to recharge the leaked electrons.
cues.zh: 注意，由于这个晶体管极其微小，宽度只有几十纳米，电子会缓慢地穿过沟道泄漏。因此，随着时间推移，电容需要刷新，以补充泄漏的电子。
